# Environment Variable Reference

<!-- GENERATED BY scripts/genEnvDocs.js — DO NOT EDIT BY HAND. -->
<!-- Regenerate with: npm run docs:env -->

Derived from every `process.env` read in `src/` and from `SETTINGS_SCHEMA` in [settings.js](src/routes/settings.js). **796 keys** across **26 groups**. Descriptions come from the Settings UI, and defaults from the engine's own fallback wherever the key is read as a literal `process.env.KEY`, so neither can drift from what actually runs. Keys reached only through a helper (`cfgOn("KEY", …)`) or through instrument.js's per-index table show the Settings default instead — that is the one the UI writes.

## ⚠️ Conflicting engine defaults

These keys are given **different fallbacks at different engine call sites**. With the key unset, behaviour depends on which module evaluated first — usually a bug.

|---|---|---|
| `BACKTEST_THETA_DAY` | `8`×12, `10`×5 | `src/routes/bbRsiBacktest.js`, `src/routes/bnPivotRsiStBacktest.js`, `src/routes/earlyBirdBacktest.js`, `src/routes/haScalpBacktest.js`, `src/routes/orbBacktest.js`, `src/routes/paBacktest.js`, `src/routes/rsiPivotStBacktest.js`, `src/routes/trendDayScalpBacktest.js`, `src/routes/trendPbBacktest.js`, `src/services/backtestEngine.js`, `src/services/ema9vwapBacktestEngine.js` |

| `EMA_RSI_ST_LIVE_ENABLED` | `false`×5, `(any but true)`×1 | `src/app.js`, `src/routes/auth.js`, `src/routes/emaRsiStLive.js`, `src/routes/emaRsiStLiveHarness.js` |
| `INSTRUMENT` | `(not NIFTY_FUTURES)`×13, ``×1 | `src/config/instrument.js`, `src/routes/bbRsiLiveHarness.js`, `src/routes/bnEmaRsiStV2LiveHarness.js`, `src/routes/bnPivotRsiStLiveHarness.js`, `src/routes/earlyBirdLiveHarness.js`, `src/routes/ema9vwapLiveHarness.js`, `src/routes/emaRsiStLiveHarness.js`, `src/routes/emaRsiStV2LiveHarness.js`, `src/routes/haScalpLiveHarness.js`, `src/routes/orbLiveHarness.js`, `src/routes/paLiveHarness.js`, `src/routes/rsiPivotStLiveHarness.js`, `src/routes/trendDayScalpLiveHarness.js`, `src/routes/trendPbLiveHarness.js` |

## BB_RSI STRATEGY (BB+SuperTrend+RSI) — Fyers

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BB_RSI_ADX_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Skip entries when the trend is too strong to fade. Stays a CEILING in breakout mode too, where it is the wrong sense — leave it off there. |
| `BB_RSI_ADX_MAX` | number | `30` | Block entries once ADX(14) reaches this (higher = more permissive). |
| `BB_RSI_BAND_WIDTH_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Skip entries when the Bollinger band is too narrow to be a real stretch. |
| `BB_RSI_BB_PERIOD` | number | `30` | Bollinger Band period. |
| `BB_RSI_BB_STDDEV` | number | `2` | Bollinger Band standard deviation. |
| `BB_RSI_CONFIRM_CANDLE_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Wait for a second candle to confirm entry. |
| `BB_RSI_CONFIRM_ON_CLOSE` | toggle | `true` | Confirmation candle must CLOSE past the signal close (off = enter intra-bar on first cross). |
| `BB_RSI_CONSEC_SL_EXTRA_PAUSE` | number | `2` | Extra pause candles per repeated stop. |
| `BB_RSI_DIRECTION` | select | `fade` | Which way the SAME signal bars are traded. Fade = buy CE below the lower band (V8, the default). Breakout = buy CE ABOVE the upper band instead. Every filter, stop and trail below is shared, so this is a clean A/B. Breakout skips the BB-middle target — the mean is behind the entry, so it would exit on the entry bar — and leaves the stop, trail and EOD as the only exits. Leave the divergence filter OFF in breakout mode: it is an exhaustion tell. |
| `BB_RSI_DIV_LOOKBACK` | number | `20` | How far back to hunt for the prior swing to compare against. |
| `BB_RSI_DIV_PIVOT_BARS` | number | `2` | Bars either side needed to confirm a swing pivot (higher = stricter, slower). |
| `BB_RSI_DIVERGENCE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Require price/RSI divergence: CE = lower low with a higher RSI low, PE = higher high with a lower RSI high. |
| `BB_RSI_ENABLED` | toggle | `(any but true)` ⚠️ also `false`×1 | Enable live orders via Fyers. |
| `BB_RSI_ENTRY_END` | time | `14:30` | No new entries after this time (IST). |
| `BB_RSI_ENTRY_START` | time | `09:21` | Earliest entry time (IST). |
| `BB_RSI_EXPIRY_DAY_ONLY` | toggle | `false` | Only trade on weekly expiry day. |
| `BB_RSI_MAX_DAILY_LOSS` | number | `2000` | Stop trading after this much loss. |
| `BB_RSI_MAX_DAILY_TRADES` | number | `30` | Max entries per day. |
| `BB_RSI_MAX_ENTRY_SL_PTS` | number | `50` | Skip entries whose signal candle is wider than this from close (0 = off). |
| `BB_RSI_MIN_BAND_WIDTH_PTS` | number | `50` | Upper minus lower band must be at least this many points. |
| `BB_RSI_OPP_CANDLE_SL_COUNT` | number | `2` | How many consecutive opposite candles trigger the stop. |
| `BB_RSI_OPP_CANDLE_SL_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Exit after N consecutive candles closing against the trade. |
| `BB_RSI_OPP_CANDLE_TRAIL_COUNT` | number | `2` | How many consecutive opposite candles trigger the trail exit. |
| `BB_RSI_OPP_CANDLE_TRAIL_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Once in profit, take over from the stop with its own opposite-candle count. |
| `BB_RSI_PER_SIDE_PAUSE` | toggle | `true` | A stop pauses only that side (CE or PE). |
| `BB_RSI_PROFIT_LOCK_PCT` | number | `50` | Once armed, exit if profit falls below this % of its peak. |
| `BB_RSI_PROFIT_LOCK_TRIGGER_PTS` | number | `0` | Optional extra upside cap — arm after this many points gained (0 = off). |
| `BB_RSI_RESOLUTION` | select | `global` | Candle timeframe for BB_RSI alone, so you can test 3-min here without moving every other strategy. Also shortens every candle-counted rule below (SL pause, opposite-candle stop/trail, confirmation candle) in proportion. |
| `BB_RSI_RSI_CE_THRESHOLD` | number | `25` | The lower-band trigger needs RSI at or below this. Fade buys CE on it; breakout buys PE. |
| `BB_RSI_RSI_PE_THRESHOLD` | number | `75` | The upper-band trigger needs RSI at or above this. Fade buys PE on it; breakout buys CE. |
| `BB_RSI_RSI_PERIOD` | number | `14` | RSI period. |
| `BB_RSI_RSI_RANGE_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Skip entries when RSI has been pinned mid-range (dead tape). |
| `BB_RSI_RSI_RANGE_LOOKBACK` | number | `20` | How many candles before the signal bar to measure RSI travel over. |
| `BB_RSI_RSI_RANGE_MIN` | number | `30` | Max minus min RSI over the lookback must be at least this. |
| `BB_RSI_RSI_TURNING` | toggle | `false` | Also require RSI to have already turned back (CE: rising, PE: falling). |
| `BB_RSI_SL_PAUSE_CANDLES` | number | `2` | Pause this many candles after a stop. |
| `BB_RSI_SLIPPAGE_PTS` | number | `1.5` | Simulated slippage per side, in points. |
| `BB_RSI_STOP_LOSS_PTS` | number | `30` | Per-tick catastrophic cap under the candle stop, which only fires on a close (0 = off). |
| `BB_RSI_TARGET_MIDDLE_BAND` | toggle | `true` | Take profit when price reverts to the mean (the middle band). Ignored in breakout mode — the mean is behind the entry there. |
| `BB_RSI_TRAIL_ARM_PTS` | number | `10` | Favourable spot points before the trail takes over from the stop (0 = immediately). |
| `BB_RSI_VIX_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Block entries when VIX is high. |
| `BB_RSI_VIX_MAX_ENTRY` | number | falls back to `VIX_MAX_ENTRY` | Block entries above this VIX. |
| `BB_RSI_VIX_STRONG_ONLY` | number | falls back to `VIX_STRONG_ONLY` | Above this VIX, allow only strong signals. |

## BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2 STRATEGY (NIFTY BANK — EMA20/50 + RSI + SuperTrend trail) — Zerodha

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_BT_SEED_PREMIUM` | number | `180` | The option price the backtest starts each trade from, since no historical option chain exists here. It is a guess, and it is the weakest number in any backtest result — more so on BANKNIFTY, where a monthly ATM premium is typically well above a NIFTY weekly's. |
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_BT_SLIPPAGE_PTS` | number | `2` | Cost the backtest charges per side, in points, to stand in for the bid-ask spread you really pay. Set it to 0 and every option-buying backtest flatters itself. BANKNIFTY monthlies are usually wider than NIFTY weeklies, so 2 is if anything optimistic here. |
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_CONFIRM_CANDLE_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | The candle that crosses only ARMS the setup — entry waits for the NEXT candle to close in the same direction. Costs you the first candle of the move but skips the crosses that immediately snap back. OFF enters on the crossing candle itself. |
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_EMA_FAST` | number | `20` | The faster of the two moving averages. A CE needs it ABOVE the slow one, a PE below. Smaller reacts to a turn sooner and gives more (and noisier) signals; larger waits for a clearer trend. |
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_EMA_SLOW` | number | `50` | The slower moving average the fast one is measured against. Raise it and the trend has to be older and better established before a cross counts; lower it and crosses come thick and fast. |
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_ENTRY_END` | time | `13:00` | No NEW entries after this time (IST). A trade opened later has too little of the day left to work. A position already open is not affected. |
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_ENTRY_START` | time | `10:30` | No entries before this time (IST). The open is deliberately skipped — the first hour is noisy and its crosses reverse, and BANKNIFTY's opening swing is the widest of the day. Move it earlier for more trades and more false starts. |
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_EOD_EXIT_TIME` | time | `14:00` | Anything still open is closed at this time (IST), stop or no stop. Nothing is carried overnight — which matters more here, because a monthly BANKNIFTY option held over a gap can move a long way before you can act on it. |
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_LIVE_DRY_RUN` | toggle | `false` | Keep this strategy simulated even when live orders are switched on — the broker call is written to the log but no real order leaves the machine. A per-strategy safety catch on top of the global one. |
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_LIVE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Send real orders to Zerodha. NEVER traded live — paper-validate a run of sessions first. Off means the harness refuses to start unless the global dry-run is also on. |
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_MAX_CONSEC_LOSSES` | number | `2` | Halt for the day after this many losing trades back to back (0 = off) — the usual sign the market is chopping and every cross is a fake. Lower reacts sooner but also quits on ordinary bad luck. |
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_MAX_DAILY_LOSS` | number | `1000` | Stop trading for the rest of the day once losses reach this much (0 = off). Read this one carefully: ₹1,000 is the same number the NIFTY version uses, but BANKNIFTY swings about twice as far in a day, so the same ₹1,000 is hit by a much smaller move against you. Expect it to end sessions earlier here. |
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_MAX_DAILY_TRADES` | number | `2` | Stop taking new entries once this many trades are done for the day. 2 is deliberately tight — the idea is a couple of good crosses, not grinding the session. |
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_OPPOSITE_SIDE_COOLDOWN_CANDLES` | number | `2` | How many candles the opposite-side pause lasts. Longer means a genuine reversal is missed; shorter means whipsaw flips get through. Ignored when the toggle above is off. |
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_OPPOSITE_SIDE_COOLDOWN_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | After an exit, also pause the OTHER side briefly, so a stopped-out CE cannot flip straight into a PE on the very next candle. OFF allows the immediate flip. |
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_PAPER_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Allow new NIFTY BANK paper sessions to start. OFF blocks the Start button — use it to park the strategy without hiding it. |
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_RSI_CE_MIN` | number | `52` | A CE (call) is only bought when RSI on the signal candle is above this. Raise it for fewer but stronger buys; lower it and weak, barely-positive momentum starts qualifying. |
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_RSI_PE_MAX` | number | `48` | A PE (put) is only bought when RSI on the signal candle is below this. Lower it for fewer but stronger sells; raise it and mild weakness starts counting as a signal. |
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_RSI_PERIOD` | number | `14` | How many candles the RSI is measured over. 14 is the standard and what the rule assumes. |
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_SL_PAUSE_CANDLES` | number | `2` | After a stop-out, refuse the SAME side for this many candles (0 = off). Stops the engine re-buying the identical failed signal a minute later. |
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_SUPERTREND_MULT` | number | `2` | How many ATRs away from price the SuperTrend line sits. Smaller = a tighter trail that banks small moves but gets shaken out often; larger = more breathing room and bigger losses when it is finally hit. Again: this is the ONLY stop, not an entry filter. |
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_SUPERTREND_PERIOD` | number | `10` | ATR length behind the SuperTrend line. THIS LINE IS THE ONLY STOP — it is a trailing exit, not an entry filter, so it never blocks a trade from being taken. Longer = a slower, looser trail that gives the trade more room. Note the ATR it measures is a BANKNIFTY ATR, so the same period sits further from price in points than it does on NIFTY. |
| `BN_EMA_RSI_ST_V2_WARMUP_DAYS` | number | `5` | How many earlier trading days of candles are loaded before the session so the EMAs, RSI and SuperTrend start the day already settled. Too few and the first signals are computed from half-formed indicators. |

## BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST STRATEGY (NIFTY BANK — RSI + Standard Pivot R1/S1 + SuperTrend) — Zerodha

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_BT_SEED_PREMIUM` | number | `180` | Starting option price the backtest assumes, since there is no historical option chain. The 25% stop is measured against this simulated premium, so it is the weakest number in any backtest result. |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_BT_SLIPPAGE_PTS` | number | `2` | Backtest cost per side, in points. Without this, option-buying backtests always flatter. |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_CONFIRM_ENABLED` | boolean | `true` | The breakout candle only arms the setup — entry waits for the NEXT candle to close past that candle's high (CE) or low (PE). Stops entries on a candle that pokes a few points past the pivot and stalls. OFF = enter on the crossing candle itself. |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_ENTRY_END` | time | — | No new entries after this time (IST) — too late in the day for a fresh trade to work out. |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_ENTRY_START` | time | — | No entries before this (IST). The first candles of the day are noisy and often break a pivot for no reason. |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_EXIT_TIME` | time | — | Everything still open is closed at this time (IST). Nothing is carried overnight. |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_LIVE_DRY_RUN` | toggle | `false` | Keep it simulated even when live is on — the broker call is logged but no real order is sent. |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_LIVE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Enable live orders via Zerodha. NEVER traded — paper-validate first. |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_LOT_MULTIPLIER` | number | `0` | Lots per trade. 0 = use the global LOT_MULTIPLIER, which is the default. |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_MAX_DAILY_LOSS` | number | `5000` | Stop trading for the day after this much loss (0 = off). |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_MAX_TRADES` | number | `5` | Max entries per day. The pivot levels are fixed all day, so a handful of crosses is all this rule can honestly produce. |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_MAX_WEEKLY_LOSS` | number | `0` | Stop trading for the rest of the week after this much loss across Mon–today (0 = off). Read from the day files, so it survives a restart. |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_PAPER_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Allow new BN Pivot RSI ST paper sessions. |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_PIVOT_BUFFER_PTS` | number | `0` | How far past R1 (or S1) the candle must close before it counts as a break. 0 = a close just beyond the level is enough. Raise it to ignore candles that only tickle the line. |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_PREMIUM_SL_PCT` | number | `25` | Exit when the option price falls this far below its best price so far. 25 means: bought at 100, exit at 75; if it runs to 140, the exit rises to 105. Which sides use it is set by the toggle below. |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_PREMIUM_SL_SIDES` | select | `BOTH` | Which side carries the premium stop. WARNING: PE has no other stop — it never uses the SuperTrend — so choosing "CE only" or "Neither" leaves every PE trade with NO stop at all, and the 15:15 square-off becomes its only exit. The same is true for CE if you also switch the SuperTrend stop off above. The engine still takes those trades but warns loudly in the log. |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_RESOLUTION` | select | `5` | Which candle decides. Entries are taken only on a CLOSED candle of this size — 5-min is the rule as written. |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_RSI_CE_MIN` | number | `70` | A CE (call) is only bought when RSI on the signal candle is above this — momentum must already be strong. Raise it for fewer, stronger buys. |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_RSI_PE_MAX` | number | `40` | A PE (put) is only bought when RSI on the signal candle is below this — selling must already be strong. Lower it for fewer, stronger sells. |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_RSI_PERIOD` | number | `14` | How many candles the RSI is measured over. 14 is the standard setting and what the rule assumes. |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_SESSION_START` | time | — | When the strategy starts watching candles for the day (IST). |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_ST_MULT` | number | `2` | How many ATRs below price the SuperTrend line sits. Smaller = a tighter stop that gets hit more often; larger = more room and bigger losses. |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_ST_PERIOD` | number | `10` | ATR length behind the SuperTrend line used as the CE stop. Longer = a slower, looser trail. |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_ST_SIDES` | select | `` | Which side uses the SuperTrend line as its stop and trail, on top of the premium stop. CE is the original rule. On PE the line is mirrored: it sits ABOVE price and a flip to bullish is the exit. A side that uses it also gains the "SuperTrend must be on the right side of price" entry check, so it takes FEWER trades; a side without it relies on the premium stop alone. |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_STRIKE_MODE` | select | `OTM` | Which strike to buy. ATM = nearest to spot. OTM = 1% of spot away from the money (cheaper, needs a bigger move). ITM = 1% into the money (costlier, moves more with spot). |
| `BN_PIVOT_RSI_ST_STRIKE_PCT` | number | `1` | How far from spot the ITM/OTM strike sits, as a percentage. 1% of a 54000 NIFTY BANK is 540 points, rounded to the nearest 100-point strike. Ignored when the mode is ATM. |

## EARLYBIRD STRATEGY (first 15-min breakout, CASH EQUITY) — Fyers

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `EARLYBIRD_BROKERAGE_PER_ORDER` | number | — | Per-leg brokerage cap used when costing a paper trade. The discount-broker standard is ₹20 or 0.03%, whichever is lower. |
| `EARLYBIRD_BT_CACHE_DAYS` | number | — | How long a cached history file survives before it is re-fetched. |
| `EARLYBIRD_BT_CONCURRENCY` | number | — | How many symbols' history are fetched in parallel during a backtest. Higher is faster but risks Fyers rate limits. |
| `EARLYBIRD_BT_DAILY_LOOKBACK_DAYS` | number | — | How far back the daily series is pulled so every simulated day has a previous close for the gap rule, even after a long holiday. |
| `EARLYBIRD_BT_MAX_SYMBOL_DAYS` | number | — | Largest run allowed, measured as symbols × trading days. The backtest holds every symbol's candles in memory at once, and this process runs with a 900 MB heap shared with live sessions — an oversized run would make PM2 restart the whole bot. 60000 ≈ one year of the full FNO universe (~186 MB of candles) or ~4 years of NIFTY50. Raise it only on a larger machine. |
| `EARLYBIRD_BT_RPM` | number | `180` | The second Fyers history window. Both this and the per-second cap are honoured. |
| `EARLYBIRD_BT_RPS` | number | `8` | Fyers meters history requests per second. Lower this if a wide-range run starts failing. |
| `EARLYBIRD_BT_SLIPPAGE_PTS` | number | — | Backtest cost per side, in rupees of stock price. Applied to both entry and exit. Without it a breakout backtest always flatters. |
| `EARLYBIRD_CHG_BROKERAGE_CAP` | number | — | Maximum brokerage per leg. The discount-broker standard is ₹20. |
| `EARLYBIRD_CHG_BROKERAGE_PCT` | number | — | Percentage brokerage per leg, before the cap below. |
| `EARLYBIRD_CHG_EXCHANGE_PCT` | number | — | NSE equity transaction charge on total turnover. Much smaller than the options rate — this is why option charges cannot be reused here. |
| `EARLYBIRD_CHG_GST_PCT` | number | — | GST charged on brokerage + exchange + SEBI fees. |
| `EARLYBIRD_CHG_SEBI_PER_CRORE` | number | — | SEBI turnover fee, in rupees per crore of turnover. |
| `EARLYBIRD_CHG_STAMP_PCT` | number | — | Stamp duty on the BUY leg of an equity-intraday trade. |
| `EARLYBIRD_CHG_STT_PCT` | number | — | Securities Transaction Tax on the SELL leg of an equity-intraday trade. NSE rate is 0.025%. |
| `EARLYBIRD_DAILY_PROFIT_LOCK` | number | — | Stop for the day once this much is banked (0 = off, the default). |
| `EARLYBIRD_ENTRY_BUFFER_PTS` | number | — | How far past the signal candle the pending order and the stop sit — "a little above the breakout candle". Applied to BOTH ends: entry beyond the extreme, stop beyond the other extreme. |
| `EARLYBIRD_ENTRY_END` | time | — | No new entries after this time (IST). The rule is 10:45; a pending order not triggered by then is cancelled. |
| `EARLYBIRD_ENTRY_START` | time | — | No entries before this (IST) — the signal candle has just closed. |
| `EARLYBIRD_FORCED_EXIT` | time | — | Hard square-off (IST). The rule is "exit at 1 pm" — anything still open closes at market here. |
| `EARLYBIRD_HISTORY_LAG_MS` | number | — | How long after 09:30 before the history endpoint is asked for the opening candle. Too short and the bar is not published yet, which would lose the whole day. |
| `EARLYBIRD_ITM_STEPS` | number | `1` | Strikes in-the-money to buy (0 = ATM). 1 step ≈ delta 0.6 — a higher delta tracks the spot move better and decays slower in percentage terms. |
| `EARLYBIRD_LIVE_DRY_RUN` | toggle | `false` | Keep it simulated even when live is on. |
| `EARLYBIRD_LIVE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Enable live CASH EQUITY orders via Fyers. NEVER traded — paper-validate first, then diff a recorded session in /replay. |
| `EARLYBIRD_MAX_CONCURRENT` | number | — | How many stocks may be held simultaneously. When more confirm than this, the tightest-stop names are taken first. |
| `EARLYBIRD_MAX_DAILY_LOSS` | number | — | Stop trading after this much loss (0 = off). Note 100 shares of a ₹3,000 stock is a ₹300,000 position — size this deliberately. |
| `EARLYBIRD_MAX_DAILY_LOSSES` | number | — | Day ends after this many stop-outs (0 = off). |
| `EARLYBIRD_MAX_DAILY_TRADES` | number | — | Max entries per day across all stocks. |
| `EARLYBIRD_MAX_GAP_PCT` | number | — | Skip a stock that opened more than this far from the previous day's close, in either direction. This is the "don't trade a stock which opened about 2% than the previous day" rule. |
| `EARLYBIRD_MAX_OPPOSING_WICK_PCT` | number | — | The wick that argues AGAINST the move — the upper wick on a green candle, the lower wick on a red one. This one number covers all three drawings: a full-body candle, a long favourable wick, and a small opposing wick. Lower = stricter. |
| `EARLYBIRD_MAX_SL_PTS` | number | — | When the wick-to-wick risk is wider than this, the stop moves off the wick and onto the candle's BODY edge (open/close) instead — the "if the breakout candle is too big, ignore the wick" rule. It can only ever tighten the stop. |
| `EARLYBIRD_MAX_WEEKLY_LOSS` | number | — | Stop for the week after this much loss (0 = off). |
| `EARLYBIRD_MIN_BODY_PCT` | number | — | The body must be a real body, as a share of the candle's own range. Stops a tiny-bodied candle with two long wicks counting as a strength candle. |
| `EARLYBIRD_MIN_CONFIRMING_STOCKS` | number | — | How many stocks must print the same-direction opening candle as NIFTY before the day is tradeable. 1 = the rule as specified. Raising it turns this into a market-breadth gate. |
| `EARLYBIRD_MIN_RANGE_PTS` | number | — | Ignore an opening candle whose whole range is smaller than this. OFF by default — the rules do not ask for it. |
| `EARLYBIRD_OPTION_LOTS` | number | — | Lots per NIFTY option trade. Only used when the mode trades options; the stock leg uses EARLYBIRD_QTY shares instead. |
| `EARLYBIRD_OPTION_LTP_RETRY_MS` | number | — | After a failed option-premium fetch, how long before the entry is retried. Stops a dead or unquoted contract from hammering the quote API on every tick while the entry window is open. |
| `EARLYBIRD_PAPER_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Allow new EarlyBird paper sessions. |
| `EARLYBIRD_POLL_MS` | number | — | How often the shortlisted stocks' prices are refreshed while setups are pending or positions are open. |
| `EARLYBIRD_QTY` | number | — | Shares per position. This is CASH EQUITY, not options — there are no lots. |
| `EARLYBIRD_QUOTE_CHUNK` | number | — | How many shortlisted symbols are requested per quote call. EarlyBird polls REST quotes for its shortlist rather than pushing equity symbols through the shared NIFTY socket. |
| `EARLYBIRD_QUOTE_STALE_SEC` | number | — | A price older than this stops being used for exit decisions, and the failure is surfaced on the status page. Stops a position being managed off a frozen quote. |
| `EARLYBIRD_RESOLUTION` | select | — | The chart the rules were read off. 15 minutes is the strategy as specified — the day's FIRST candle is the signal candle. |
| `EARLYBIRD_SCAN_CONCURRENCY` | number | — | How many symbols are fetched in parallel during the 09:30 scan. Each one issues two calls (intraday + daily), so the real number in flight is double this. |
| `EARLYBIRD_SCAN_RPM` | number | `180` | The second Fyers history window. Both this and the per-second cap are honoured. |
| `EARLYBIRD_SCAN_RPS` | number | `8` | Fyers meters history calls per second. Exceeding it makes Fyers answer 'no data' — indistinguishable from a delisted stock — so an over-fast scan silently reports most of the universe as having no candle. A full ~220-name scan takes about 2 minutes at this rate, well inside the entry window. |
| `EARLYBIRD_SEBI_PCT` | number | — | SEBI fee as a percentage of turnover (₹10 per crore). |
| `EARLYBIRD_SESSION_START` | time | — | Where the day's first candle begins (IST). This is the signal candle. |
| `EARLYBIRD_STAMP_PCT` | number | — | Stamp duty on the BUY leg only. |
| `EARLYBIRD_STT_PCT` | number | — | Securities Transaction Tax on the SELL leg. Equity intraday is 0.025%, far below the options rate. |
| `EARLYBIRD_TARGET_RR` | number | — | Book profit at this multiple of the actual risk. 2 = the 1:2 in the rules; set 1 for the 1:1 the rules also allow. |
| `EARLYBIRD_TRADE_MODE` | select | `stock` | stock = buy/short the CASH EQUITY of the F&O stocks that confirm NIFTY's signal (the original rules). option = buy ONE NIFTY CE/PE off NIFTY's own opening candle and DO NOT check any stock. both = run the two legs at once, independently. Note the stock leg needs stock confirmation; the option leg never does. |
| `EARLYBIRD_TXN_PCT` | number | — | NSE equity transaction charge on total turnover. |
| `EARLYBIRD_UNIVERSE` | select | `FNO` | Which list of stocks is scanned at 09:30. FNO (~220 names) is the list from the strategy's own stock-selection slides. |
| `EARLYBIRD_WARMUP_DAYS` | number | — | How far back to fetch. Only the previous daily close is strictly needed (for the gap rule), so this is small by design. |

## EMA_RSI_ST STRATEGY (EMA 20/50 + RSI + SuperTrend) — Zerodha

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `EMA_RSI_ST_CANDLE_TRAIL_BARS` | number | `3` | Candles looked back for the trailing stop. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_CANDLE_TRAIL_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Add a candle-based trailing stop. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_CLOSE_BEYOND_EMA_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Candle must close on the trade side of the EMA. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_CONFIRM_CANDLE_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Wait for a second candle to confirm entry. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_EMA_EXIT_MODE` | select | `touch` | How the EMA21 line ends a trade. Touch = today's rule: the candle only has to REACH EMA21, and EMA21 is also the tick-by-tick stop, so a single wick closes the trade. Cross &amp; close = wicks through the line are held and the trade exits only when a candle CLOSES beyond EMA21 (CE on a close below it, PE on a close above). In cross &amp; close mode EMA21 stops being the tick stop — otherwise the first wick would stop you out anyway — so keep the Candle Trail on (or a points Stop Loss) to hold the hard stop. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_EMA_FAST` | number | `20` | Fast EMA period. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_EMA_FASTEST` | number | `9` | Fastest EMA period (triple-stack only). |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_EMA_SLOW` | number | `50` | Slow EMA period. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_EMA_TRIPLE_STACK_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Require a 9>20>50 EMA stack (stricter). |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_EOD_EXIT_TIME` | time | `15:15` | Close any open position at this time (IST). |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_INITIAL_SL_MODE` | select | `prev_candle` | Where the stop sits the moment you enter. Previous candle = today's rule: the stop is the last completed candle's low (CE) / high (PE) — structural, but often only a few points from the fill, so ordinary noise stops the trade out within seconds. EMA21 = seed the stop on the SAME EMA21 line the trail already rides, so entry protection and trail protection are one line. EMA21 usually sits further from price, which means fewer instant stop-outs but a bigger loss when it is hit. Applied only when EMA21 is on the protective side of the fill (below entry for CE, above for PE); otherwise the previous-candle stop is kept. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_LIVE_DRY_RUN` | toggle | `false` | Keep this strategy simulated even when live is on. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_LIVE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` ⚠️ also `(any but true)`×1 | Enable live orders via Zerodha. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_MAX_CONSEC_LOSSES` | number | `0` | Stop for the day after this many losses in a row (0 = off). |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_NEG_CANDLE_LIMIT` | number | `2` | Exit if still losing after this many candles (0 = off). |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_OPPOSITE_SIDE_COOLDOWN_CANDLES` | number | `3` | Opposite-side cooldown length in candles. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_OPPOSITE_SIDE_COOLDOWN_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Pause the opposite side briefly after an exit. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_SL_PAUSE_CANDLES` | number | `3` | Pause the same side this many candles after a stop (0 = off). |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_STOP_LOSS_PTS` | number | `0` | Max loss per trade in points (0 = off). |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_SUPERTREND_MULT` | number | `3` | SuperTrend band width multiplier. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_SUPERTREND_PERIOD` | number | `10` | SuperTrend ATR period. |
| `MAX_DAILY_LOSS` | number | `5000` | Stop trading after this much loss. |
| `MAX_DAILY_TRADES` | number | `20` | Max entries per day. |
| `OPT_STOP_PCT` | number | `0.15` | Exit if option premium drops this fraction. |
| `RSI_CE_MAX` | number | `80` | Block CE when RSI is this high (overbought). |
| `RSI_CE_MIN` | number | `52` | CE needs RSI above this. |
| `RSI_PE_MAX` | number | `48` | PE needs RSI below this. |
| `RSI_PE_MIN` | number | `20` | Block PE when RSI is this low (oversold). |
| `TRADE_ENTRY_END` | time | `14:00` | No new entries after this time (IST). |
| `TRADE_ENTRY_START` | time | `10:30` | Earliest entry time (IST). |
| `TRADE_EXPIRY_DAY_ONLY` | toggle | `false` | Only trade on weekly expiry day. |
| `VIX_FILTER_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Block entries when VIX is high. |
| `VIX_MAX_ENTRY` | number | `20` ⚠️ also `22`×2 | Block entries above this VIX. |

## EMA_RSI_ST_V2 STRATEGY (EMA20/50 + RSI + SuperTrend trail) — Zerodha

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_BT_SEED_PREMIUM` | number | `180` | The option price the backtest starts each trade from, since no historical option chain exists here. It is a guess, and it is the weakest number in any V2 backtest result. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_BT_SLIPPAGE_PTS` | number | `2` | Cost the backtest charges per side, in points, to stand in for the bid-ask spread you really pay. Set it to 0 and every option-buying backtest flatters itself. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_CONFIRM_CANDLE_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | The candle that crosses only ARMS the setup — entry waits for the NEXT candle to close in the same direction. Costs you the first candle of the move but skips the crosses that immediately snap back. OFF enters on the crossing candle itself. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_EMA_FAST` | number | `20` | The faster of the two moving averages. A CE needs it ABOVE the slow one, a PE below. Smaller reacts to a turn sooner and gives more (and noisier) signals; larger waits for a clearer trend. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_EMA_SLOW` | number | `50` | The slower moving average the fast one is measured against. Raise it and the trend has to be older and better established before a cross counts; lower it and crosses come thick and fast. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_ENTRY_END` | time | `13:00` | No NEW entries after this time (IST). A trade opened later has too little of the day left to work, and theta is eating it. A position already open is not affected. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_ENTRY_START` | time | `10:30` | No entries before this time (IST). V2 deliberately skips the open — the first hour is noisy and its crosses reverse. Move it earlier for more trades and more false starts. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_EOD_EXIT_TIME` | time | `14:00` | Anything still open is closed at this time (IST), stop or no stop. Nothing is carried overnight. Note V2 squares off at 14:00 — much earlier than most strategies — which caps both the loss and the run. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_LIVE_DRY_RUN` | toggle | `false` | Keep V2 simulated even when live orders are switched on — the broker call is written to the log but no real order leaves the machine. A per-strategy safety catch on top of the global one. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_LIVE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Send real orders to Zerodha. NEVER traded live — paper-validate a run of sessions first. Off means the harness refuses to start unless the global dry-run is also on. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_MAX_CONSEC_LOSSES` | number | `2` | Halt for the day after this many losing trades back to back (0 = off) — the usual sign the market is chopping and every cross is a fake. Lower reacts sooner but also quits on ordinary bad luck. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_MAX_DAILY_LOSS` | number | `1000` | Stop trading for the rest of the day once losses reach this much (0 = off). Raise it and a bad day can run further; lower it and one ordinary loser can end the session. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_MAX_DAILY_TRADES` | number | `2` | Stop taking new entries once this many trades are done for the day. 2 is deliberately tight — V2 is meant to take a couple of good crosses, not grind the session. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_OPPOSITE_SIDE_COOLDOWN_CANDLES` | number | `2` | How many candles the opposite-side pause lasts. Longer means a genuine reversal is missed; shorter means whipsaw flips get through. Ignored when the toggle above is off. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_OPPOSITE_SIDE_COOLDOWN_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | After an exit, also pause the OTHER side briefly, so a stopped-out CE cannot flip straight into a PE on the very next candle. OFF allows the immediate flip. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_PAPER_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Allow new EMA_RSI_ST_V2 paper sessions to start. OFF blocks the Start button — use it to park the strategy without hiding it. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_RSI_CE_MIN` | number | `52` | A CE (call) is only bought when RSI on the signal candle is above this. Raise it for fewer but stronger buys; lower it and weak, barely-positive momentum starts qualifying. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_RSI_PE_MAX` | number | `48` | A PE (put) is only bought when RSI on the signal candle is below this. Lower it for fewer but stronger sells; raise it and mild weakness starts counting as a signal. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_RSI_PERIOD` | number | `14` | How many candles the RSI is measured over. 14 is the standard and what the rule assumes. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_SL_PAUSE_CANDLES` | number | `2` | After a stop-out, refuse the SAME side for this many candles (0 = off). Stops the engine re-buying the identical failed signal a minute later. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_SUPERTREND_MULT` | number | `2` | How many ATRs away from price the SuperTrend line sits. Smaller = a tighter trail that banks small moves but gets shaken out often; larger = more breathing room and bigger losses when it is finally hit. Again: this is the ONLY stop V2 has, not an entry filter. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_SUPERTREND_PERIOD` | number | `10` | ATR length behind the SuperTrend line. THIS LINE IS V2'S ONLY STOP — it is a trailing exit, not an entry filter, so unlike V1 the SuperTrend never blocks a trade from being taken. Longer = a slower, looser trail that gives the trade more room. |
| `EMA_RSI_ST_V2_WARMUP_DAYS` | number | `5` | How many earlier trading days of candles are loaded before the session so the EMAs, RSI and SuperTrend start the day already settled. Too few and the first signals are computed from half-formed indicators. |

## HA SCALP STRATEGY (Heikin Ashi 15m) — Zerodha

| Key | Type | Default | Description |

| `HA_SCALP_BT_SEED_PREMIUM` | number | `240` | Assumed entry premium for the backtest (₹). |
| `HA_SCALP_BT_SLIPPAGE_PTS` | number | `1.5` | Backtest cost per side, in points. Without this, option-buying backtests always flatter. |
| `HA_SCALP_DAILY_PROFIT_LOCK` | number | `0` | Stop for the day once this much is banked (0 = off, the default). |
| `HA_SCALP_DOJI_BODY_PCT` | number | `20` | A candle whose body is this small a share of its range counts as a doji. |
| `HA_SCALP_ENTRY_END` | time | — | No new entries after this time (IST). |
| `HA_SCALP_ENTRY_START` | time | — | No entries before this (IST). |
| `HA_SCALP_EXIT_ON_DOJI` | toggle | `true` | A doji warns of a trend reversal — close the trade. Colour is irrelevant: a doji ends the trend question either way. |
| `HA_SCALP_EXIT_ON_WEAK` | toggle | `true` | The trend is fading — close the trade. Covers both an opposite-coloured candle and a same-coloured one whose body has shrunk. |
| `HA_SCALP_FORCED_EXIT` | time | `15:15` | Hard square-off time (IST). A trade no candle rule has closed is closed here. |
| `HA_SCALP_HA_CONTINUOUS` | toggle | `true` | ON = the HA candle carries over the overnight gap, which is what TradingView draws. OFF reseeds each day and the charts would then disagree with the platform the rules came from. |
| `HA_SCALP_HA_WARMUP_BARS` | number | `20` | No decision until this many bars are behind us. haOpen is a running average, so the first few candle colours are seed artefacts rather than signal. |
| `HA_SCALP_HISTORY_LAG_MS` | number | `5000` | How long after a bar closes before the Fyers history endpoint is asked for it. Too short and the bar is not published yet, which delays every decision by a whole candle. |
| `HA_SCALP_ITM_STEPS` | number | `1` | Strikes in-the-money to buy (0 = ATM). 1 step ≈ delta 0.6. |
| `HA_SCALP_LIVE_DRY_RUN` | toggle | `false` | Keep it simulated even when live is on. |
| `HA_SCALP_LIVE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Enable live orders via Zerodha. NEVER traded — paper-validate first. |
| `HA_SCALP_LOT_MULTIPLIER` | number | `0` | Lots per trade. 0 = use the global LOT_MULTIPLIER, which is the default (1 lot). |
| `HA_SCALP_MA_PERIOD` | number | `50` | The moving average that decides the side. Above it, CE only; below it, PE only. Computed on RAW closes, like the platform default. |
| `HA_SCALP_MA_TYPE` | select | `sma` | Simple or exponential. The rules were read off a plain 50 MA. |
| `HA_SCALP_MAX_DAILY_LOSS` | number | `3000` | Stop trading after this much loss (0 = off). |
| `HA_SCALP_MAX_DAILY_LOSSES` | number | `2` | Day ends after this many stop-outs (0 = off). |
| `HA_SCALP_MAX_DAILY_TRADES` | number | `3` | Max entries per day. |
| `HA_SCALP_MAX_SL_PTS` | number | `0` | Skip the setup when the signal candle's extreme is further away than this. OFF by default: the rule says that candle IS the stop, however wide. |
| `HA_SCALP_MAX_WEEKLY_LOSS` | number | `0` | Stop for the week after this much loss (0 = off). |
| `HA_SCALP_MAX_WICK_PCT` | number | `0` | How much wick still counts as none, as a share of the candle's own range. 0 = exactly wick-free, which is the rule as specified and is deliberately strict — expect few trades. Raising it to 5–10 loosens the entry. |
| `HA_SCALP_MIN_BODY_PTS` | number | `5` | A body smaller than this is not a strength candle. Without it, a flat candle satisfies "no wick" trivially. |
| `HA_SCALP_PAPER_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Allow new HA Scalp paper sessions. |
| `HA_SCALP_POLL_MS` | number | `2000` | How often the option premium is refreshed while a trade is open. Spot comes from the shared tick socket, so nothing else is polled. |
| `HA_SCALP_RESOLUTION` | select | `15` | The chart the rules were read off. 15 minutes is the strategy as specified — the repo-wide 5-min default does not apply here. |
| `HA_SCALP_SESSION_START` | time | — | Where the session's bars start being counted (IST). |
| `HA_SCALP_SL_BUFFER_PTS` | number | `0` | Stop sits this far past the signal candle's raw high/low, so a one-tick poke does not take it out. 0 = exactly on the candle's extreme, as the rule states. |
| `HA_SCALP_WARMUP_DAYS` | number | `15` | How far back to fetch on start so the MA and the HA chain are established. At 25 bars a session, 15 calendar days is comfortably more than the ~51 bars needed, even across holidays. |
| `HA_SCALP_WEAK_BODY_PCT` | number | `40` | A same-direction candle with a body below this share of its range is weak. Must sit above the doji threshold to mean anything separate. |

## Instrument & Backtest

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BACKTEST_CAPITAL` | number | `100000` | Backtest Capital (₹) |
| `BACKTEST_DELTA` | number | `0.55` | Option delta for premium simulation. |
| `BACKTEST_OPTION_SIM` | toggle | `true` | Simulate option P&L in the legacy backtest. |
| `BACKTEST_SLIPPAGE_PTS` | number | `1.5` | Simulated slippage per side, in points. |
| `BACKTEST_THETA_DAY` | number | `8` ⚠️ also `10`×5 | Daily theta decay in rupees. |
| `BANKNIFTY_FUTURES_MARGIN_PCT` | number | `11` | SPAN+exposure margin as % of notional, used to size the capital pool when the Trade Type is futures. Advisory only — never blocks a trade. |
| `BANKNIFTY_LOT_SIZE` | number | `30` | Quantity per NIFTY BANK lot — 30 since NSE's Nov-2024 revision. |
| `BANKNIFTY_OPTION_EXPIRY_OVERRIDE` | date | — | Manual NIFTY BANK expiry (YYYY-MM-DD) for every NIFTY BANK strategy. Filled in automatically once the stored one expires, exactly as the NIFTY 50 key above is — the roll runs per index, so each one gets its own monthly/weekly date. A future date you set is left alone. A date that has already passed BLOCKS NIFTY BANK entries rather than quietly trading a different expiry. |
| `BANKNIFTY_OPTION_EXPIRY_TYPE` | select | `monthly` | Monthly is the only real answer today — NSE WITHDREW BANKNIFTY weekly options in November 2024, so there is no weekly NIFTY BANK contract to name. Weekly is honoured only if the Weekly Expiries Exist toggle above is switched on, which is there purely for the day NSE reverses that decision. |
| `BANKNIFTY_SPOT_FALLBACK` | number | `54000` | Fallback NIFTY BANK price when no live quote is available. |
| `BANKNIFTY_STRIKE_OFFSET_CE` | number | `0` | CE strike vs ATM, in points on the 100-point grid (-100=ITM, 0=ATM, +100=OTM). |
| `BANKNIFTY_STRIKE_OFFSET_PE` | number | `0` | PE strike vs ATM, in points on the 100-point grid (+100=ITM, 0=ATM, -100=OTM). |
| `BANKNIFTY_STRIKE_STEP` | number | `100` | The strike grid this index is listed on. NIFTY BANK strikes exist every 100 points, so the ATM strike is spot rounded to the nearest 100. Change it only if NSE changes the grid. |
| `BANKNIFTY_WEEKLY_EXPIRY_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | OFF, and it must stay off: NSE WITHDREW BANKNIFTY weekly options in November 2024, so every NIFTY BANK contract is the MONTHLY one. This toggle exists only for the day NSE changes its mind — switching it on lets the engine build weekly (YYMDD) symbols again, and until that day those symbols simply do not exist, so every entry would be refused. |
| `BB_RSI_LIVE_DRY_RUN` | toggle | `false` | Keep BB_RSI simulated even when live is on. |
| `BB_RSI_LIVE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Second gate for BB_RSI Live. Off = BB_RSI stays simulated even with the global switch off. |
| `CHART_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Show the candlestick chart on status pages. |
| `EXPIRY_AUTO_ROLL_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | When the expiry above is blank or expired, replace it with the next one automatically. |
| `EXPIRY_HEALTHCHECK_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Check before the open that the expiry names a contract the broker quotes. |
| `EXPIRY_HEALTHCHECK_MINS` | number | — | How often to re-check the expiry (08:00–15:30 IST). After the close it always runs at 15:40, retrying at 16:15 / 16:30 / 16:45, so a just-expired date rolls the same day. |
| `FYERS_INV_AMOUNT` | number | `100000` | Paper money pool for Fyers strategies (₹). |
| `GAP_THRESHOLD_PTS` | number | `50` | Skip the first candle on a big overnight gap. |
| `HARD_SL_DELTA` | number | `0.5` | Delta used to convert the spot stop to a premium trigger. |
| `HARD_SL_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Place a stop-loss order at the exchange on entry. |
| `HARNESS_EXCHANGE_SL_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Leave a stop-loss order at the exchange for harness-run strategies (Trend PB, EMA9+VWAP, TDS). Off = the stop only lives in this process and dies with it. |
| `HARNESS_SL_PCT` | number | `0.5` | How far below the entry premium that stop sits. 0.5 = trigger at half the premium paid. |
| `INSTRUMENT` | select | `(not NIFTY_FUTURES)` ⚠️ also ``×1 | Options (CE/PE) or Futures. |
| `LIVE_EXIT_WAIT_MS` | number | — | How long to wait on a live exit before alerting (ms). |
| `LIVE_HARNESS_DRY_RUN` | toggle | `true` | Global switch: log live orders but place none. |
| `LOT_MULTIPLIER` | number | `1` | Number of lots per trade. |
| `LTP_STALE_FALLBACK_SEC` | number | `5` | Use candle close if the option price is older than this (sec). |
| `LTP_STALE_THRESHOLD_SEC` | number | `15` | Warn if the option price hasn't updated for this long (sec). |
| `MAX_BID_ASK_SPREAD_PTS` | number | `2` | Reject entries when the spread is wider than this. |
| `NIFTY_FUTURES_MARGIN_PCT` | number | `11` | SPAN+exposure margin as % of notional, used to size the capital pool when Trade Type is NIFTY_FUTURES. Advisory only — never blocks a trade. |
| `NIFTY_LOT_SIZE` | number | — | Quantity per lot. |
| `NIFTY_SPOT_FALLBACK` | number | `24000` | Fallback NIFTY price when no live quote. |
| `NIFTY_STRIKE_STEP` | number | `50` | The strike grid this index is listed on. NIFTY 50 strikes exist every 50 points, so the ATM strike is spot rounded to the nearest 50. Change it only if NSE changes the grid. |
| `NIFTY_WEEKLY_EXPIRY_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | NIFTY 50 lists a weekly (Tuesday) contract as well as the monthly one, so this stays ON. Turning it off makes every NIFTY 50 expiry resolve to the month contract instead. |
| `OPTION_CHAIN_RECORD_INTERVAL_SEC` | number | `5` | How often to record the option chain (sec). |
| `OPTION_CHAIN_RECORD_OI` | toggle | `true` | Also capture each strike's Open Interest from the same quotes (no extra API calls). Feeds the OI Monitor and chain_oi.jsonl. Fyers has no historical-OI API, so turning this off means that day's OI is gone for good. |
| `OPTION_CHAIN_RECORD_STRIKES` | number | `5` | Strikes each side of ATM to record. |
| `OPTION_CHAIN_RECORDER_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Record the option chain for replay. |
| `OPTION_CHART_BAR_MIN` | number | `` | Candle size for the option premium chart. 1-15 minutes. |
| `OPTION_CHART_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Show the traded contract's own premium chart under the spot chart. Built from live ticks, so it is empty until a position opens. |
| `OPTION_EXPIRY_OVERRIDE` | date | — | Option expiry for every NIFTY 50 strategy — NIFTY BANK has its own BANKNIFTY_OPTION_EXPIRY_OVERRIDE, because the two indices expire on different calendars. Filled in automatically once the stored one expires; a future date you set is left alone. |
| `OPTION_EXPIRY_TYPE` | select | `weekly` | Weekly or monthly expiry. |
| `OPTION_SOCKET_FEED_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Get held option prices from the live feed instead of repeated REST polls. Off = every strategy polls on its own timer. |
| `OPTION_SOCKET_FRESH_MS` | number | `4000` | Older than this and the strategy falls back to a REST poll. |
| `OPTION_SOCKET_LEASE_MS` | number | `15000` | A contract is unsubscribed this long after the last strategy stops asking for it. |
| `OPTION_SOCKET_RECORD_MS` | number | `1000` | How often streamed option prices are written to the replay recording. |
| `PA_LIVE_DRY_RUN` | toggle | `false` | Keep PA simulated even when live is on. |
| `PA_LIVE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Second gate for PA Live. Off = PA stays simulated even with the global switch off. |
| `PAPER_CAPITAL_EST_PREMIUM` | number | `200` | EMA_RSI_ST / EMA9+VWAP / BB_RSI / PA decide before their option quote arrives — this premium is assumed for the check, then corrected to the real one a second later. |
| `PAPER_CAPITAL_GATE_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Treat the investment amounts as real money: block qty × premium on entry, release it with the P&L on exit, so profits grow the pool and losses shrink it. Running out never stops a trade — the Real-Time dashboard raises an alert instead. Off = display only. |
| `SPOT_FEED_ALWAYS_ON` | toggle | `true` | Record the spot feed all day, even with no strategy running. |
| `STRIKE_OFFSET_CE` | number | `0` | CE strike vs ATM (-50=ITM, 0=ATM, +50=OTM). |
| `STRIKE_OFFSET_PE` | number | `0` | PE strike vs ATM (+50=ITM, 0=ATM, -50=OTM). |
| `TICK_RECORDER_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Record ticks so sessions can be replayed. |
| `TICK_RECORDER_RETAIN_DAYS` | number | `30` | Delete tick recordings older than this. |
| `TIME_STOP_CANDLES` | number | `4` | Default time-stop window, in candles. |
| `TIME_STOP_FLAT_PTS` | number | `20` | Flat-P&L band that triggers the time-stop. |
| `TRADE_RESOLUTION` | select | `5` | Candle timeframe in minutes. One global setting — every strategy uses it. |
| `TRADE_START_TIME` | time | `09:15` | Market open time (IST). |
| `TRADE_STOP_TIME` | time | `15:30` | Auto-stop and square-off time (IST). |

## ORB STRATEGY (Opening Range Breakout) — Fyers

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ORB_BODY_ATR_MULT` | number | `0` | Breakout candle must be at least this decisive. |
| `ORB_BODY_OR_CAP` | number | `0` | Ceiling on the body filter as a share of today's opening range. ATR(5m) comes from previous days, so after a violent day it can demand a body bigger than today's whole range (2026-08-06: 22.2pt needed vs a 38.95pt range). 0.25 = never ask for more than a quarter of the range. Can only let MORE breakouts through. |
| `ORB_BREAKEVEN_OR_MULT` | number | `0` | Scale the breakeven trigger by range width (0 = off). |
| `ORB_BREAKEVEN_PTS` | number | `20` | Move stop to entry after this many points profit (0 = off). |
| `ORB_BREAKOUT_RESCAN` | toggle | `true` | OFF = the first close beyond the range is final, even if it fails the body filter (old behaviour). |
| `ORB_BT_SEED_PREMIUM` | number | `240` | Assumed entry premium for the backtest (₹). |
| `ORB_BT_SLIPPAGE_PTS` | number | `1.5` | Backtest cost per side, in points. |
| `ORB_BUFFER_ATR_MULT` | number | — | Second half of the buffer; the larger of this and the ×OR value wins. |
| `ORB_BUFFER_MIN_PTS` | number | `0` | Absolute floor on the breakout buffer. Set all three buffer fields to 0 for a plain close past the line. |
| `ORB_BUFFER_OR_MULT` | number | — | How far past the range edge a close must be. Lowering it takes more trades but measurably worse ones (PF 0.93 → 0.64 at 0.10 on the Mar–Apr 2026 sample) — leave it alone. |
| `ORB_CANDLE_TRAIL_CANDLES` | number | `2` | How many candles the trailing stop must clear. 1 = the just-closed candle's low/high (tightest). 2 = that candle and the one before it, matching the 'lookback' initial stop. |
| `ORB_CANDLE_TRAIL_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Once a candle closes in profit, move the hard stop to the extreme of the last N candles, and keep moving it up candle by candle. Tighten-only — a pullback never widens it. Runs alongside the EMA trail; whichever ends the trade first wins. UNPROVEN — measure with scripts/orbSweep.js. |
| `ORB_CONFIRM_MODE` | select | `close` | extend = next candle needs a higher high AND higher close beyond the edge. close = it only has to close beyond the breakout candle's close. |
| `ORB_DEBUG_TRACE` | toggle | `false` | Log why entries did or didn't fire (verbose). |
| `ORB_ENTRY_END` | time | `11:30` | No new entries after this time (IST). |
| `ORB_ENTRY_START` | time | `` | No breakout candle is even looked at before this (blank/09:30 = start hunting the moment the range freezes). Skips the 09:35-type entries — but MEASURE IT FIRST: on the Jul–Aug 2026 export the early trades lost less than the late ones (−₹2,372 over 9 before 09:50 vs −₹4,213 over 8 after) and a delay deletes the sample's two best trades. |
| `ORB_EXPIRY_DAY_ONLY` | toggle | `false` | Only trade on weekly expiry day. |
| `ORB_FORCED_EXIT` | time | `15:15` | Hard end-of-day exit time (IST). |
| `ORB_GAP_OR_MULT` | number | `0` | Skip the day on an oversized overnight gap. |
| `ORB_ITM_STEPS` | number | `1` | Strikes in-the-money to trade (0 = ATM). |
| `ORB_LIVE_DRY_RUN` | toggle | `false` | Keep ORB simulated even when live is on. |
| `ORB_LIVE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Enable live ORB orders via Fyers. |
| `ORB_LOSS_STREAK_SKIP` | number | `4` | Skip a day after this many losing days (0 = off). |
| `ORB_MAX_DAILY_LOSS` | number | `3000` | Stop taking NEW entries once the day is down this much. It cannot close a trade that is already open, and with Max Trades/Day = 1 the budget is spent anyway — raise Max Trades/Day for it to bite. |
| `ORB_MAX_DAILY_TRADES` | number | `1` | Max entries per day. |
| `ORB_MAX_SPREAD_PTS` | number | falls back to `MAX_BID_ASK_SPREAD_PTS` | Skip entry if the bid-ask spread is wider than this. |
| `ORB_MAX_TRADE_LOSS` | number | `0` | Ships OFF so the structural stop is the real stop. When set it clamps the placed SL, which is tighter than the strategy's own level on most trades — use Max Daily Loss for risk control instead. |
| `ORB_MAX_WEEKLY_LOSS` | number | `9000` | Stop for the week after this much loss (0 = off). |
| `ORB_OPP_CANDLE_BODY_MULT` | number | `0.3` | Reversal candle body vs range width to trigger the exit. |
| `ORB_OPP_CANDLE_EXIT` | toggle | `false` | Exit on a strong reversal candle. |
| `ORB_OR_ATR_MAX` | number | `0` | Skip the day if the opening range is too wide. |
| `ORB_OR_MAX_PTS` | number | `0` | Skip the day when the opening range is wider than this many points. Measure with scripts/orbSweep.js before enabling. |
| `ORB_PREMIUM_GATE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Skip entries when the option price is out of range. |
| `ORB_PREMIUM_MAX` | number | `400` | Skip entry if the option price is above this (₹). |
| `ORB_PREMIUM_MIN` | number | `120` | Skip entry if the option price is below this (₹). |
| `ORB_PREMIUM_STOP_PCT` | number | `35` | Exit if the option premium drops this % (0 = off). |
| `ORB_RANGE_END` | time | `09:30` | Opening-range end time (IST). |
| `ORB_RANGE_START` | time | `09:15` | Opening-range start time (IST). |
| `ORB_REENTRY_AFTER_SL` | number | `0` | Extra attempts allowed after the breakout is STOPPED OUT, on top of Max Trades/Day. The hunt re-arms past the stop candle, so only a genuinely fresh close beyond the same range edge can re-enter (2026-08-03 would re-enter 10:45, 2026-07-29 at 10:05). An EMA-trail or EOD exit never re-arms — that means the move ended, not that the breakout was wrong. UNPROVEN: measure with scripts/orbSweep.js before leaving it on. |
| `ORB_RETEST_MAX_WAIT` | number | `6` | Candles to wait for a retest or resume (0 = off). |
| `ORB_RISK_THROTTLE_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Pause after a bad week or a losing streak. |
| `ORB_RSI_CE_MIN` | number | `51` | CE entries need RSI at or above this. |
| `ORB_RSI_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | CE needs RSI at or above the CE floor, PE at or below the PE ceiling, read on the candle being bought. Off = no RSI check. |
| `ORB_RSI_PE_MAX` | number | `49` | PE entries need RSI at or below this. |
| `ORB_RSI_PERIOD` | number | `14` | RSI lookback on 5-min closes. |
| `ORB_SL_ATR_MULT` | number | `0` | Initial stop width as a multiple of ATR. |
| `ORB_SL_LOOKBACK_CANDLES` | number | `2` | Only read when the anchor is 'lookback'. 2 = the entry candle and the one before it — the stop clears the recent swing instead of a single bar. Ignored by the other two anchors. |
| `ORB_SL_SOURCE` | select | `breakout` | Where the initial stop sits: under the entry candle, under the first candle that closed past the range edge, under the extreme of the last N candles ending at the entry candle (lookback, N below), or on the SuperTrend line (supertrend — period and multiplier below, and the one anchor the SuperTrend trail can then keep moving). |
| `ORB_SL_ST_MULT` | number | `2` | ATR multiplier of the stop SuperTrend. Lower = the line rides closer to price, so the stop is tighter and trails faster. 2 with period 10 is the classic intraday stop setting. |
| `ORB_SL_ST_PERIOD` | number | `10` | ATR period of the SuperTrend used as the STOP — read by the 'supertrend' anchor above and by the SuperTrend trail below. Separate from the entry gate's SuperTrend on purpose: a direction filter wants a slower band, a stop wants a tighter one. |
| `ORB_ST_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | CE only when SuperTrend is bullish, PE only when bearish, read on the candle being bought. Off = no SuperTrend check. |
| `ORB_ST_MULT` | number | `3` | SuperTrend ATR multiplier. |
| `ORB_ST_PERIOD` | number | `10` | SuperTrend ATR period. |
| `ORB_ST_TRAIL_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | On every candle close, move the hard stop onto the SuperTrend line set by the two Stop — SuperTrend fields above (10 / 2 by default), while SuperTrend agrees with the trade. Tighten-only — a widening band never pushes the stop back out — and never placed at the close itself. Because it moves the HARD stop it exits intrabar, not on a close. Set the stop anchor to 'supertrend' as well and the initial stop and the trail are the same line. Runs alongside the EMA and candle trails; whichever ends the trade first wins. IMPORTANT: turn the Candle Trail OFF when you use this — a 2-candle low sits much nearer price than a 2xATR band, so with both on the candle trail wins nearly every ratchet and this one almost never binds. UNPROVEN — measure with scripts/orbSweep.js. |
| `ORB_TRAIL_ARM_PTS` | number | `0` | The trail cannot exit until the trade is this many points in profit; only the hard stop and the ₹ cap apply before that. Entry is the confirmation candle's close, so price is often already extended and the next candle pulls back through the EMA. UNPROVEN — measure with scripts/orbSweep.js before moving it off 0. |
| `ORB_TRAIL_CONFIRM_CLOSES` | number | `1` | How many closes in a row on the wrong side of the EMA before exiting. 1 = today's rule. 2 rides out one noise candle but gives back a bar when the move is really over. |
| `ORB_TRAIL_EMA` | number | `20` | Trail exit: leave when price closes back across this EMA. |
| `ORB_VIX_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Block entries when VIX is high. |
| `ORB_VIX_MAX_ENTRY` | number | `22` | Block entries above this VIX. |
| `ORB_VIX_STRONG_ONLY` | number | falls back to `VIX_STRONG_ONLY` | Above this VIX, allow only strong signals. |
| `ORB_VWAP_FILTER_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Measured worthless here: it removed 0 of 36 breakouts on the Mar–Apr 2026 sample. Off costs nothing and skips the VWAP maths. |

## RSI_PIVOT_ST STRATEGY (RSI + Standard Pivot R1/S1 + SuperTrend) — Zerodha

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_BT_SEED_PREMIUM` | number | `180` | Starting option price the backtest assumes, since there is no historical option chain. The 25% stop is measured against this simulated premium, so it is the weakest number in any backtest result. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_BT_SLIPPAGE_PTS` | number | `2` | Backtest cost per side, in points. Without this, option-buying backtests always flatter. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_CONFIRM_ENABLED` | boolean | `true` | The breakout candle only arms the setup — entry waits for the NEXT candle to close past that candle's high (CE) or low (PE). Stops entries on a candle that pokes a few points past the pivot and stalls. OFF = enter on the crossing candle itself. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_ENTRY_END` | time | — | No new entries after this time (IST) — too late in the day for a fresh trade to work out. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_ENTRY_START` | time | — | No entries before this (IST). The first candles of the day are noisy and often break a pivot for no reason. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_EXIT_TIME` | time | — | Everything still open is closed at this time (IST). Nothing is carried overnight. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_LIVE_DRY_RUN` | toggle | `false` | Keep it simulated even when live is on — the broker call is logged but no real order is sent. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_LIVE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Enable live orders via Zerodha. NEVER traded — paper-validate first. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_LOT_MULTIPLIER` | number | `0` | Lots per trade. 0 = use the global LOT_MULTIPLIER, which is the default. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_MAX_DAILY_LOSS` | number | `5000` | Stop trading for the day after this much loss (0 = off). |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_MAX_TRADES` | number | `5` | Max entries per day. The pivot levels are fixed all day, so a handful of crosses is all this rule can honestly produce. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_MAX_WEEKLY_LOSS` | number | `0` | Stop trading for the rest of the week after this much loss across Mon–today (0 = off). Read from the day files, so it survives a restart. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_PAPER_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Allow new RSI Pivot ST paper sessions. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_PIVOT_BUFFER_PTS` | number | `0` | How far past R1 (or S1) the candle must close before it counts as a break. 0 = a close just beyond the level is enough. Raise it to ignore candles that only tickle the line. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_PREMIUM_SL_PCT` | number | `25` | Exit when the option price falls this far below its best price so far. 25 means: bought at 100, exit at 75; if it runs to 140, the exit rises to 105. Which sides use it is set by the toggle below. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_PREMIUM_SL_SIDES` | select | `BOTH` | Which side carries the premium stop. WARNING: PE has no other stop — it never uses the SuperTrend — so choosing "CE only" or "Neither" leaves every PE trade with NO stop at all, and the 15:15 square-off becomes its only exit. The same is true for CE if you also switch the SuperTrend stop off above. The engine still takes those trades but warns loudly in the log. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_RESOLUTION` | select | `5` | Which candle decides. Entries are taken only on a CLOSED candle of this size — 5-min is the rule as written. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_RSI_CE_MIN` | number | `70` | A CE (call) is only bought when RSI on the signal candle is above this — momentum must already be strong. Raise it for fewer, stronger buys. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_RSI_PE_MAX` | number | `40` | A PE (put) is only bought when RSI on the signal candle is below this — selling must already be strong. Lower it for fewer, stronger sells. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_RSI_PERIOD` | number | `14` | How many candles the RSI is measured over. 14 is the standard setting and what the rule assumes. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_SESSION_START` | time | — | When the strategy starts watching candles for the day (IST). |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_ST_MULT` | number | `2` | How many ATRs below price the SuperTrend line sits. Smaller = a tighter stop that gets hit more often; larger = more room and bigger losses. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_ST_PERIOD` | number | `10` | ATR length behind the SuperTrend line used as the CE stop. Longer = a slower, looser trail. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_ST_SIDES` | select | `` | Which side uses the SuperTrend line as its stop and trail, on top of the premium stop. CE is the original rule. On PE the line is mirrored: it sits ABOVE price and a flip to bullish is the exit. A side that uses it also gains the "SuperTrend must be on the right side of price" entry check, so it takes FEWER trades; a side without it relies on the premium stop alone. |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_STRIKE_MODE` | select | `OTM` | Which strike to buy. ATM = nearest to spot. OTM = 1% of spot away from the money (cheaper, needs a bigger move). ITM = 1% into the money (costlier, moves more with spot). |
| `RSI_PIVOT_ST_STRIKE_PCT` | number | `1` | How far from spot the ITM/OTM strike sits, as a percentage. 1% of a 24000 NIFTY is 240 points, rounded to the nearest 50-point strike. Ignored when the mode is ATM. |

## SIMPLE_9:30 STRATEGY (option-premium breakout) — Zerodha

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SIMPLE930_BAND_DOWN_OFFSET` | number | `20` | Lower edge of the box, resolved as trigger − this — 160 at the defaults. Honest caveat: with a 20pt stop the trade is already out at fill−20 long before the premium can fall this far, so this edge is unreachable in practice. It becomes live only once the stop is widened past the offset. |
| `SIMPLE930_BAND_UP_OFFSET` | number | `40` | Upper edge of the box, resolved as trigger + this — 220 at the defaults. Touching it counts as leaving the box, so the 09:45 exit stops applying. Setting it to 0 puts the box top ON the trigger, and since every fill is above the trigger the trade counts as expanded immediately — that DISABLES the 09:45 sideways exit entirely. Use 0 only if that is what you want. |
| `SIMPLE930_BT_SLIPPAGE_PTS` | number | — | Backtest cost per side, in points. Without this, option-buying backtests always flatter. |
| `SIMPLE930_ENTRY_END` | time | — | If neither watchlist leg has cleared the trigger by this time (IST) there is no trade today — nothing re-arms later in the session. |
| `SIMPLE930_ENTRY_START` | time | — | Entries are allowed from this moment (IST). It opens with the watchlist rather than at 09:30 because the rule is take it as soon as it is above the trigger, not wait for a round number. |
| `SIMPLE930_FORCED_EXIT` | time | — | Hard square-off time (IST) for a trade that expanded out of the box and that the trail never took out. |
| `SIMPLE930_LIVE_DRY_RUN` | toggle | `false` | Keep it simulated even when live is on. |
| `SIMPLE930_LIVE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Enable live orders via Zerodha. NEVER traded, paper or live — paper-validate first, then diff a recorded session in /replay. |
| `SIMPLE930_LOT_MULTIPLIER` | number | `0` | Lots per trade. 0 = use the global LOT_MULTIPLIER, which is the default. |
| `SIMPLE930_LTP_STALE_MS` | number | `15000` | Refuse an entry when the last premium is older than this. A stalled quote feed would otherwise buy a break that happened minutes ago, at a price that no longer exists. |
| `SIMPLE930_MAX_DAILY_LOSS` | number | `0` | Stop trading after this much loss (0 = off). |
| `SIMPLE930_MAX_DAILY_TRADES` | number | `1` | The rule is one trade a day — the entry window shuts at 09:35 and nothing re-arms after it, so raising this only bites if the window is widened too. |
| `SIMPLE930_MAX_PREMIUM_DIST` | number | `0` | 0 = off, the default. When set, a side whose nearest strike is further than this from the trigger is not watched at all that day — no contract on that side is close enough for a break of the level to mean anything. |
| `SIMPLE930_MIN_PREMIUM` | number | `0` | 0 = off, the default. Rungs quoting cheaper than this are thrown out of the 09:25 ladder before the pick is made, so a near-worthless contract cannot win the search on a thin quote. |
| `SIMPLE930_PAPER_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Allow new SIMPLE_9:30 paper sessions. |
| `SIMPLE930_POLL_MS` | number | `1000` | How often the two watchlist premiums are fetched. This is the granularity the trigger AND every exit are checked at — the shared tick socket carries the INDEX, and every decision this strategy makes is read off an option premium. |
| `SIMPLE930_SCAN_ITM_STRIKES` | number | `8` | How deep in-the-money the 09:25 ladder reaches on each side. 8 × 50 = 400 points, which covers a ₹180 premium from a fresh weekly (barely ITM) to expiry day (almost all intrinsic). |
| `SIMPLE930_SCAN_OTM_STRIKES` | number | `0` | 0 = the rule as written (ATM + ITM only). Raise it when the whole ITM ladder sits ABOVE the trigger, which happens on a fresh weekly where even the ATM contract is dearer than ₹180 — without an OTM rung there is nothing near the level to pick. |
| `SIMPLE930_SELECTION_TIME` | time | — | The single instant (IST) the ITM ladder is quoted and the day's two candidates — one CE, one PE — are frozen. It never re-picks: a watchlist that drifts with spot could not be re-derived by Replay. |
| `SIMPLE930_SIDEWAYS_CHECK` | time | — | At this time (IST) a trade still boxed inside the band below is closed at market, whatever the P&L — it spent the whole move going nowhere. A trade that already left the box is left alone and the trail owns it from there. |
| `SIMPLE930_SL_PTS` | number | `20` | A DISTANCE below the ACTUAL fill, not a fixed level: filled at 181 gives a stop at 161, filled at 186 gives 166. Anchoring it to the trigger instead would hand a slipped fill a wider stop than the rule allows. |
| `SIMPLE930_SUSTAIN_POLLS` | number | `1` | 1 = enter on the first quote above the trigger, which is the rule as written. Higher demands that many CONSECUTIVE quotes above it before buying — fewer one-print fakeouts, but every extra quote costs a poll interval of the move. |
| `SIMPLE930_TRAIL_ARM_AT_BAND_UP` | toggle | `true` | Keep the trail parked until the premium actually touches the top of the sideways box (Trigger + Band Up Offset). Until then the flat stop is the only risk. Off makes the trail live from the fill, which turns a 20pt stop into a much tighter one on the first rupee of noise. |
| `SIMPLE930_TRAIL_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Ratchet the stop up behind the highest premium seen since entry. Off leaves the initial stop where it was placed for the life of the trade. |
| `SIMPLE930_TRAIL_PTS` | number | `20` | How far under the highest premium seen since entry the trail sits: peak 200 gives a stop at 180. It only ever ratchets UP and never drops below the initial stop. |
| `SIMPLE930_TRIGGER_PREMIUM` | number | `180` | This ONE number does both jobs, because in the rule they are the same ₹180: the 09:25 search keeps the strike trading nearest it, and the same level is what a premium must trade above to be bought. The sideways box is stored as offsets around it, so moving this moves the whole geometry together instead of leaving a band around a level nothing trades near. |

## TREND DAY SCALP STRATEGY — Fyers

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TDS_ATR_PERIOD` | number | `14` | ATR that scales the conviction body. |
| `TDS_BODY_ATR_MULT` | number | `0.4` | The reclaim candle's body must be at least this × ATR — the conviction gate. |
| `TDS_BREAKEVEN_BUFFER_PTS` | number | `3` | Where the stop lands on that jump: entry ± this. It never moves again. |
| `TDS_BREAKEVEN_R` | number | `1` | Favourable move at which the stop makes its ONE jump. |
| `TDS_BT_SEED_PREMIUM` | number | `240` | Assumed entry premium for the backtest (₹). |
| `TDS_BT_SLIPPAGE_PTS` | number | `1.5` | Backtest cost per side, in points. Without this, option-buying backtests always flatter. |
| `TDS_DAILY_PROFIT_LOCK` | number | `3000` | Stop for the day once this much is banked (0 = off). Giving profit back is what wrecks a steady curve. |
| `TDS_EMA_PERIOD` | number | `20` | The pullback zone is whichever of VWAP / this EMA sits nearer to price. |
| `TDS_ENTRY_END` | time | — | No new entries after this time (IST). |
| `TDS_EXTENSION_MULT` | number | `0.20` | Spot must sit this many × the first-hour range away from VWAP. MEASURED over 39 sessions: median 0.18, p90 0.39 — so 0.35 passed only 13% of days and starved the strategy. 0.20 is just above the median. |
| `TDS_FORCED_EXIT` | time | `15:10` | Hard square-off time (IST). |
| `TDS_GATE_TIME` | time | `10:15` | The one moment the day is judged trendable (IST). Decided once, then frozen. |
| `TDS_ITM_STEPS` | number | `1` | Strikes in-the-money to buy (0 = ATM). 1 step ≈ delta 0.6. |
| `TDS_LIVE_DRY_RUN` | toggle | `false` | Keep it simulated even when live is on. |
| `TDS_LIVE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Enable live orders via Fyers. NEVER traded — paper-validate first. |
| `TDS_LOT_MULTIPLIER` | number | `0` | Lots per trade (0 = use global). |
| `TDS_MAX_DAILY_LOSS` | number | `3000` | Stop trading after this much loss (0 = off). Raised with the stop cap — at 1500 a single 40pt stop-out ends the day, making the trade budget a dead letter. |
| `TDS_MAX_DAILY_LOSSES` | number | `2` | Day ends after this many REAL stop-outs (0 = off). Breakeven and time-stop exits do not count. |
| `TDS_MAX_DAILY_TRADES` | number | `2` | Max entries per day. Friction is per-trade, so fewer is usually better. |
| `TDS_MAX_SL_PTS` | number | `40` | A wider structural stop SKIPS the trade entirely. MEASURED: real pullback stops are median 35pt, so the old 18 skipped 48 of 53 setups and kept only the shallowest. 40pt covers ~p60. Note ~35pt ≈ ₹1,400 premium risk on 1 lot. |
| `TDS_MAX_WEEKLY_LOSS` | number | `0` | Stop for the week after this much loss (0 = off). |
| `TDS_MIN_RANGE_PCT` | number | `0.5` | The day must have actually moved. A dead range has no juice for an option buyer. |
| `TDS_MIN_SL_PTS` | number | `12` | A tighter structural stop is widened to this — never tightened inside the structure. |
| `TDS_PAPER_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Allow new Trend Day Scalp paper sessions. |
| `TDS_PREMIUM_STOP_PCT` | number | `25` | Exit if the option itself drops this % (0 = off). Catches an IV crush the spot stop cannot see. |
| `TDS_PULLBACK_WINDOW` | number | `3` | How many recent bars can supply the pullback touch. A wick counts. |
| `TDS_RESOLUTION` | select | `5` | Signal + exit candle timeframe. |
| `TDS_SESSION_START` | time | — | Where the first-hour range and the VWAP both start (IST). |
| `TDS_TARGET_R` | number | `2.5` | Fixed target as a multiple of the stop distance. Taken, never trailed past. |
| `TDS_TIME_STOP_MINS` | number | `25` | Flat if breakeven has not armed within this long (0 = off). A stalled option only pays theta. |
| `TDS_VWAP_STREAK_BARS` | number | `6` | How many of the last closes must all sit on the same side of VWAP. |

## TREND PULLBACK STRATEGY — Fyers

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TREND_PB_ATR_FLOOR_PTS` | number | `0` | Skip when volatility is below this (0 = off). |
| `TREND_PB_ATR_PERIOD` | number | `14` | ATR period. |
| `TREND_PB_BODY_ATR_MULT` | number | `0.5` | Resumption candle body vs ATR (conviction). |
| `TREND_PB_BREAKEVEN_R` | number | `1.0` | Move stop to entry after this much gain (× risk, 0 = off). |
| `TREND_PB_BT_SEED_PREMIUM` | number | `240` | Assumed entry premium for the backtest (₹). |
| `TREND_PB_BT_SLIPPAGE_PTS` | number | `1.5` | Backtest cost per side, in points. |
| `TREND_PB_EMA_EXIT_ENABLED` | toggle | `true` | Exit when a 5m candle closes back across the EMA. Off = only stop/trail/time-stop close the trade. |
| `TREND_PB_ENTRY_END` | time | `14:30` | No new entries after this time (IST). |
| `TREND_PB_ENTRY_START` | time | `09:45` | No entries before this time (IST). |
| `TREND_PB_FORCED_EXIT` | time | `15:15` | Hard square-off time (IST). |
| `TREND_PB_ITM_STEPS` | number | `1` | Strikes in-the-money to buy (0 = ATM). |
| `TREND_PB_LIVE_DRY_RUN` | toggle | `false` | Keep this strategy simulated even when live is on. |
| `TREND_PB_LIVE_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Enable live orders via Fyers. |
| `TREND_PB_LOSS_STREAK_SKIP` | number | `3` | Pause for the day after this many losses in a row (0 = off). |
| `TREND_PB_MAX_DAILY_LOSS` | number | `5000` | Stop trading after this much loss. |
| `TREND_PB_MAX_DAILY_TRADES` | number | `3` | Max entries per day. |
| `TREND_PB_MAX_SPREAD_PTS` | number | falls back to `MAX_BID_ASK_SPREAD_PTS` | Skip entry if the bid-ask spread is wider than this. |
| `TREND_PB_MIN_PULLBACK_BARS` | number | `2` | Minimum against-trend candles for a real pause. |
| `TREND_PB_OI_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Block entries fighting an OI buildup. |
| `TREND_PB_PREMIUM_MAX` | number | `400` | Skip entry if the option price is above this (₹). |
| `TREND_PB_PREMIUM_MIN` | number | `120` | Skip entry if the option price is below this (₹). |
| `TREND_PB_PREMIUM_STOP_PCT` | number | `35` | Exit if the option premium drops this % (0 = off). |
| `TREND_PB_PULLBACK_MAX_ATR` | number | `1.5` | Reject pullbacks deeper than this. |
| `TREND_PB_PULLBACK_WINDOW` | number | `6` | Bars counted as the pullback. |
| `TREND_PB_STOP_CLAMP_MAX` | number | `30` | Largest allowed stop distance, in points. |
| `TREND_PB_STOP_CLAMP_MIN` | number | `8` | Smallest allowed stop distance, in points. |
| `TREND_PB_SWING_LOOKBACK` | number | `2` | Bars each side that define a swing point. |
| `TREND_PB_TIME_STOP_CANDLES` | number | `6` | Exit if flat after this many candles (0 = off). |
| `TREND_PB_TRAIL_ATR_MULT` | number | `2.5` | Trailing stop distance as a multiple of ATR. |
| `TREND_PB_TRAIL_EMA` | number | `20` | Exit when price closes back across this EMA. |
| `TREND_PB_VIX_ENABLED` | toggle | `false` | Block entries when VIX is out of range. |
| `TREND_PB_VIX_MAX_ENTRY` | number | falls back to `VIX_MAX_ENTRY` | Block entries above this VIX. |

## UI PREFERENCES

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `UI_DISABLE_RIGHT_CLICK` | toggle | `` | Block the browser right-click menu on every page. Text boxes keep their menu so copy and paste still work. |
| `UI_THEME` | select | — | Switch between dark and light mode. auto = light during the day (06:00–18:00 IST) and dark at night; each page picks its theme when it loads. |
